My bullish bet: as more agents get permission to move money, developers have stronger reasons to pay for protection. If $WORM turns that demand into recurring revenue, those buybacks could become a much stronger driver.

Adoption has to deliver. But protecting the wallets behind the AI economy? That’s a thesis I can get behind. 🔥
